sourceTitle: Advice to a Young Man upon First Going to Oxford In Ten Letters, From an Uncle to His Nephew
description: "Advice to a Young Man upon First Going to Oxford" by Edward Berens is a collection of letters written in the early 19th century. The letters, addressing his nephew, offer guidance on navigating the challenges and responsibilities that come with attending the University of Oxford.
